_about: Tasks for the user evaluation. All personal details are synthetic. 'planted' marks a detail the detector is known to miss (a lowercase first name, a date of birth, a health detail), so the study can measure whether participants catch misses during review. 'method' is 'assigned' when the method is set by participant number (counterbalanced), or 'choice' when the participant picks.

tasks.title: Practice
tasks.instructions: Practice task. You want an AI assistant to make this message sound more professional. Use the tool to protect the personal details, then create the safer prompt.
tasks.prompt: Can you make this sound more professional? Hi Megan Clarke, thanks for your call. I'll send the form to megan.clarke@example.com today. Call me back at (519) 836-2291 if anything is missing.

tasks.title: Shift swap email
tasks.instructions: You want an AI assistant to write an email to your manager. Make sure no personal details reach the AI, then create the safer prompt and paste it into the AI assistant.
tasks.prompt: Write a short, polite email to my manager Karen Liu asking if I can swap my Friday shift with Tomás Rivera. Tomás already agreed. Karen can reach me at 226-904-1187 or jordan.ellis@example.org. Sign it from me, Jordan Ellis. cc priya too, she covers fridays.

tasks.title: Support tickets

tasks.prompt:

tasks.title: Deposit advice
tasks.instructions: You want advice from an AI assistant. This time, choose whichever method you prefer. Make sure no personal details reach the AI, then create the safer prompt and paste it into the AI assistant.

I was diagnosed with Crohn's disease last year, so I can't easily go to the office in person. My SIN is 130 692 544 if it matters for the tenant board. What should I do?
